notes: Start the app with: npm run start
Needs values for: SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_API_KEY. Secret-like values are asked for at run time and never stored.
Stripe dashboard: an account or API key is needed.
postgres on port 5432 is expected; the compose file defines it but the native path does not start it.
redis on port 6379 is expected; the compose file defines it but the native path does not start it.
